subject: MatrixAI renewal — PO, billing contact, and tax form for capacity add
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@matrixai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: MatrixAI Finance <finance@matrixai.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal PO & billing contact update for Q3 capacity add

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team is excited to finalize the capacity add that kicks in July 1. Per procurement, I've attached the official PO. A few asks from our side before you invoice: 

- Please issue the invoice to: MatrixAI US Holdings, LLC (EIN: 12-3456789)
- Net terms requested: Net45 (this is standard for our finance team)
- Billing contact should be: accounts-payable@matrixai.com (cc included)
- We also need Redwood's completed W-9 on file before payment can be released — can you provide that?

I'm attaching PO_8921_MatrixAI.pdf with the PO number at the top. If you need a purchase order field in your system, use PO-8921-MATX.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, MatrixAI
[Attachment: PO_8921_MatrixAI.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@matrixai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal PO & billing contact update for Q3 capacity add

Hi Elena — thanks, got the PO and the billing info. Looping in Monica (billing owner) and Marcus (renewal lead) to align on terms and get the W-9 over to you. Quick notes from our side: 

- We'll aim to honor Net45 for this renewal as requested. Monica, can you confirm?
- We'll create the invoice referencing PO-8921-MATX and send it to accounts-payable@matrixai.com.
- Finance will require Redwood's W-9 (we typically produce that from our legal team) — Monica, will upload the W-9 to the invoice thread.

Elena — if MatrixAI needs any additional recipient (AP portal URL or vendor code), please send that and we'll add it to the invoice metadata.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the tag, Karthik. Monica here from Finance — happy to confirm we can process Net45 for this renewal as a one-off for the Q3 capacity addition. A couple of operational items I need to close: 

- Please confirm the legal payee name and EIN you want on the invoice exactly as it should appear (Elena listed MatrixAI US Holdings, LLC / EIN: 12-3456789).
- We require either a Redwood W-9 or scanning of the vendor profile to accept PO-8921-MATX. I'll attach a draft invoice (stub) for review; final invoice will be generated once I receive Redwood's W-9 and the signed SOW.
- If MatrixAI uses an AP portal (PO portal) please share a direct link and vendor code so we can push the invoice there as well.

Uploading initial stub: Redwood_Invoice_INV-2028-0021.pdf (draft).

I'll mark this as Net45 and add PO-8921-MATX to the invoice header. Elena — if you can send the W-9 (or confirm you have it on file for Redwood), we can finalize and get the invoice out next week.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_INV-2028-0021.pdf]

Hi Monica,

Thanks — confirmed legal payee and EIN are correct. Attached is Redwood's W-9 that we completed during vendor onboarding (file name MatrixAI requested we use). I also added our vendor code (MATX-556) for your accounts system.

A couple final items from procurement: 
- Please include the full PO line for the capacity uplift (SKU: RU-XL-1M) on the invoice so it maps to our internal GL.
- Payment remittance will be via ACH to the bank details on the invoice; our AP team will process 45 days after invoice date.

I've attached the W-9 as requested: MatrixAI_W9_2028.pdf.

Best,
Elena
[Attachment: MatrixAI_W9_2028.pdf]
